The following comments on the draft statement should be addressed during preparation of the final statement.
Air Quality
1. Page 40. Air quality standards have been established to provide protection to the Public Health and Welfare. The table on page 40 should include all National Ambient Air Quality Standards (NAAQS) for each pollutant as well as the appropriate averaging times. 
2. The table on page 41 should include the averaging times. The table should also indicate the number of violations of Federal standards and the number of violations of State standards.
23. A discussion of the nonattainment designation should be included since the Bay Area has been designated as a nonattainment area for CO, and O..
O4. The final statement needs to explain what the two numbers represent under Average Daily Traffic. 
5. The statement should include Peak Hour Volume and road capacity.
6. Highways 101, 17, and 280 are currently experiencing traffic volumes beyond road capacity. How will this project affect traffic flows/congestion on these roads? Will the project increase Vehicle Miles Traveled (VMT) in San Jose?
7. The final statement needs to address the impact of the project on the NAAQS. Will there be an increase in the number of violations?
